model_source: ../r1_reproduction/run.py model: unchanged; fixed strain, variable layer potentials +/-D
root_method: Unchanged r1_events.Solver.root, supplied the checked affine fractional-momentum/D Hamiltonian; carry each previous root as the next seed. Both grids start from original D38 roots.

paths.static_D38: Shifted a to shifted b, connector to collinear b, collinear b to collinear a, connector back to shifted a, all at D38.
paths.center_ribbon: p38 to q38; sampled q(D) to q39; q39 to p39; sampled p(D) back to p38. Each boundary edge is affine in (f1,f2,D).
paths.shifted_ribbon: Add (r,0) to every momentum vertex of center_ribbon.

adaptive_rule: For each affine edge and interval h, delta = h*||H_end-H_start||_2. Exterior-gap lower estimate=min(g_left,g_right)-delta-floating_allowance. Require lower>margin, delta/lower<=level threshold, and subspace overlap>=level threshold. Otherwise bisect; retain unresolved leaves. No holonomy label is accepted if any leaf fails.
holonomy: Multiply O(2) polar factors of F_i.T F_(i+1), including closure without forcing determinant +1. Compare with iterative projector transport, reversed traversal, and reproducible independent local O(2) gauge changes.
hypothesis_policy: Predictions from prior charge/path data are separate from numerical validity. Report disagreement rather than changing thresholds or replacing evidence. Require matching signs across meshes and engines.
analytic_controls: Contour through adjacent degeneracy: isolation rejection, no accepted sign
scope: Numerical orientation holonomy of the isolated flat-band pair on explicitly specified closed contours, plus sampled node continuation. This does not certify continuous root identity, a full non-Abelian braid, Euler-class removal, novelty, infinite-cutoff accuracy, or experimental realization. Isolation estimates remain conditional floating-point bounds, not interval arithmetic.
